the MT1-MMP–FGFR4-R388 complex acts as a tumor invasion switch.
the FGFR4-R338 polymorphism acts as a switch for the MT1-MMP–FGFR4 membrane complex.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the FGFR4-R338 allele, linked to a poor clinical outcome in several cancers, forms a complex with MT1-MMP that stimulates MT1-MMP–mediated collagen invasion and suppresses the lysosomal degradation of MT1-MPP.
FGFR4-R488 is a tumor progression-associated allele of FGFR4 that is associated with poor cancer prognosis.
MT1-MMP has a dual role as a positive and negative regulator of FGFR4 activity.
